help.title: Check for the Johnson transformation type and parameters associated with the selected variables
help.body:
Description
Check for the associated Johnson transformation type and parameters, if any, for the selected variables with a prior Johnson transformation

When the companion Johnson transformation dialog stores a transformed variable, it records the transformation as attributes of the variable: jtrans_type (SB, SL, or SU), jtrans_z (the Z value of the best fit), and the parameters jtrans_gamma (γ), jtrans_eta (η), jtrans_epsilon (ε), jtrans_lambda (λ). This dialog displays those values in a table, and prints the reconstructed transformation function for each transformed variable below the table. Variables without a stored Johnson transformation are excluded from the table and listed separately below it

The three Johnson transformation functions
SB (bounded): γ + η * Ln( (X - ε) / (λ + ε - X) )
SL (lognormal): γ + η * Ln( X - ε )
SU (unbounded): γ + η * Asinh( (X - ε) / λ )

The correct type and parameters are important as they will be used if an inverse Johnson transformation is needed. Use the companion Add/Replace/Remove Johnson parameters dialog to correct them if needed
